headline: GOLD SURGES 3%, SILVER 4.7% IN FRIDAY REVERSAL — IN-LINE PCE SNAPS FOUR-WEEK LOSING STREAK WITH MONTH-END BUYING
snippet: Gold surged approximately 3% and silver leaped 4.7% on Friday June 27, 2026, staging the most decisive intraday reversal of the current correction cycle after May's Personal Consumption Expenditures inflation index printed at 4.1% year-over-year — exactly in line with consensus — giving the dollar permission to retreat and trimming December rate-hike odds from 85% to 80%. Gold spot recovered from a mid-week low near $3,950 to close above $4,089, while silver rose from approximately $56.50 to $59.15. Despite Friday's bounce, gold remains down approximately 3% for the week — its fourth consecutive weekly decline since January's all-time high of $5,589/oz. GoldSilver.com identifies five structural forces behind the rally beyond the PCE headline: month-end institutional rebalancing, a sharp drop in real yields on the inflation read, a technical bounce from long-term moving average support near $3,950, short-covering ahead of Thursday's Nonfarm Payrolls report, and renewed physical demand from Asian buyers re-entering at prices below $4,000. For junior mining investors, Friday's reversal is technically significant: mining equities have been hit harder than the metal itself during the correction, creating a valuation gap that closes fastest when the metal finds a floor.

headline: EQUINOX GOLD AND ORLA MINING MAIL PROXY FOR US$18.5B MERGER — TARGETS 500,000+ OZ/YR IN AMERICAS; VOTE JULY 22
snippet: Equinox Gold Corp. (TSX/NYSE:EQX) mailed meeting materials to shareholders on June 23, 2026 for a special meeting scheduled July 22, 2026 to approve its all-share business combination with Orla Mining Ltd. (TSX:OLA) — the final major milestone before closing a transaction valued at approximately US$18.5 billion. Each Orla share converts into 1.00 Equinox share plus US$0.0001, with former Orla shareholders expected to own approximately 33% of the combined company. The merged entity would combine Orla's flagship Camino Rojo heap-leach mine in Mexico, Equinox's producing assets in Brazil and the United States, and the advanced Oko West development project in Guyana into a single portfolio targeting production exceeding 500,000 ounces of gold per year — a scale comparable to mid-tier majors like Kinross Gold but with a materially lower projected all-in sustaining cost profile. Canadian and Mexican competition clearances have already been received; the Orla board unanimously recommends voting in favour, backed by fairness opinions from two independent financial advisors. For junior mining investors, the strategic implication is broader than the deal itself: a newly formed 500,000-oz/yr Americas-focused producer with a clean balance sheet creates both a new consolidator of junior assets and a new benchmark for what disciplined gold company-building looks like in the 2026 market.

headline: CHINA BLACKLISTS MP MATERIALS AND USA RARE EARTH — TERBIUM +22.8% TO $969/KG, GERMANIUM AT 2026 HIGH
snippet: China's Ministry of Commerce added 10 U.S. companies to its export control list on June 22, 2026, including MP Materials Corp. (NYSE:MP) — operator of the Mountain Pass rare earth mine in California — and USA Rare Earth Inc. (Nasdaq:USAR), which is building a mine-to-magnet supply chain in Texas. The designation bars Chinese entities from supplying dual-use items to these companies and prohibits any organisation worldwide from transferring Chinese-origin dual-use products to them, effectively severing both companies from Chinese REE processing equipment and technology. Beijing stated the action was retaliation after the U.S. Pentagon added approximately 80 Chinese companies to its military entity list in early June. Market impacts have been immediate: terbium surged 22.8% in June to $969.69/kg, germanium reached a 2026 high of $2,673.66/kg, and China's Rare Earth Price Index climbed to 261.9 — extending a rally that began in mid-2025. Outside China, terbium oxide is trading at approximately US$4,500/kg — nearly five times the Chinese domestic price — as Western buyers compete for the magnetic rare earths essential for EV motors, wind turbines, and defence systems. For junior rare earth explorers in safe jurisdictions, each escalation in China's export control posture structurally improves the value proposition of Western-hosted separation and refining capacity that today barely exists.

headline: PROSPECTOR METALS DEPLOYS THIRD RIG AT YUKON ML — TESS DISCOVERY EXPANDING TO SKARN RIDGE TARGETS (TSXV:PPP)
source_name: Investing News Network / Prospector Metals Corp. (TSXV:PPP)
snippet: Prospector Metals Corp. (TSXV:PPP) provided a drilling update on June 25, 2026 confirming that 15 holes (3,203 metres) have been completed to date at the ML Project in Yukon and that a third drill rig was anticipated on site on June 27. Two rigs have been focused on the TESS Zone discovery, which Prospector discovered in late 2025 and which has returned highlight intervals of 44 metres grading 13.79 g/t gold, 1.84% copper, and 38.08 g/t silver — including 24.65 metres at 21.93 g/t Au — and 14 metres at 7.29 g/t gold with 0.91% copper. The third rig expands the programme from focused TESS step-out drilling to a district-scale test, targeting continued step-outs at Skarn Ridge, drilling across both northern and southern contacts of the ML intrusive stock to evaluate intrusion-hosted mineralisation, and additional priority targets under investigation. The combination of gold and copper in wide intervals at TESS is characteristic of the early-stage geometry that precedes porphyry-system identification in Yukon geology, and the deployment of three concurrent rigs testing multiple structural targets marks the transition from early discovery to systematic programme — the stage at which the most consequential geological interpretation decisions get made.

headline: POWER METALLIC LION ZONE: 13.30M AT 3.98% CUEQ NEAR SURFACE — MAIDEN MRE DUE JULY, PEA TO FOLLOW (TSXV:PNPN)
source_name: PR Newswire / Power Metallic Mines Inc. (TSXV:PNPN)
snippet: Power Metallic Mines Inc. (TSXV:PNPN / OTCQB:PNPNF) released additional drill results from its winter 2026 programme at the Lion Zone of the Nisk Project in northern Quebec on June 24, 2026, headlined by hole PML-26-115 intersecting 13.30 metres grading 3.98% copper equivalent from 25 metres below surface, and hole PML-26-105 returning 5.26 metres at 8.45% CuEq from approximately 140 metres depth. Hannam & Partners noted that the combination of grade, width, and structural continuity across the infill programme supports the potential for an Indicated resource classification in the maiden NI 43-101 Mineral Resource Estimate, scheduled for completion by the end of July 2026 alongside an updated MRE for the Nisk deposit — two resource milestones in a single month. Locked-cycle metallurgical testing has returned copper recoveries of 98.3% at a concentrate grade of 25.4% copper, with gold, palladium, and platinum recoveries in the mid-to-high 80% range — an unusually clean metallurgical profile that eliminates processing risk as a valuation discount. The company plans to commence a Preliminary Economic Assessment immediately after the July MRE. For copper investors, the catalyst sequence — near-surface high-grade, clean metallurgy, MRE, then PEA — is the precise progression that drives the most decisive re-ratings in copper junior development stories, and Power Metallic is now one milestone away from crossing the threshold where market scepticism about the deposit begins to resolve into institutional confidence.

headline: K2 GOLD DRILLS DRAGONFLY — ZONE WHERE IT PREVIOUSLY HIT 86.9M AT 4.0 g/t AU FROM SURFACE; CALIFORNIA (TSXV:KTOV)
source_name: Investing News Network / K2 Gold Corporation (TSXV:KTOV)
snippet: K2 Gold Corporation (TSXV:KTOV) commenced its 2026 exploration and drilling programme at the 100%-owned Mojave Project in Inyo County, California on June 25, 2026, initiating an initial 5,650-metre campaign within an approved Plan of Operations that permits up to approximately 14,000 metres across the Eastern Target Area. The first holes focus on the Dragonfly Zone, where K2's 2025 programme returned the company's standout discovery intercept: 86.9 metres grading 4.0 g/t gold from surface, including 24.4 metres at 10.9 g/t gold — a result that would rank among the top discovery holes on the TSX Venture Exchange in almost any year. Additional target areas across the property include Newmont, Gold Valley, Soda Valley, and Morningstar, all identified through historical and recent exploration but not yet systematically drilled. For retail gold investors, K2 Gold's Mojave story has a straightforward structure: a defined, high-grade discovery interval in a U.S. jurisdiction, a secured Plan of Operations, and a 2026 programme designed to test whether the Dragonfly Zone is a standalone body or the expression of a larger mineralised system. The programme launched into a gold price environment that, despite the recent correction from $5,589, still prices any ounce found in the ground at approximately $4,000 — making near-surface, high-grade California gold among the more economically compelling exploration targets in the current market.

headline: TRACTION URANIUM AIRBORNE SURVEY AT AURORA ATHABASCA — 16KM FROM CAMECO KEY LAKE; DRILL PROGRAM SEPTEMBER
source_name: GlobeNewswire / Traction Uranium Corp. / Cosa Resources Corp. (TSXV:COSA)
snippet: Cosa Resources Corp. announced June 25, 2026 that a property-wide airborne radiometric survey has commenced at the Aurora uranium project in Saskatchewan's southeastern Athabasca Basin, funded entirely by Traction Uranium Corp. under an option agreement giving Traction the right to earn up to an 80% interest in Aurora by sole-funding $9.15 million in exploration expenditures. The survey is being flown at 50-metre line spacing using Calgary-based Special Projects Inc.'s custom 16-detector focused gamma-ray spectrometer — a resolution capable of detecting the subtle radioactive signatures associated with mineralised boulders and outcrops that coarser historical surveys miss. Aurora sits approximately 16 kilometres east of Cameco's Key Lake Mill and historical mine, providing a direct processing infrastructure reference point that distinguishes it from the many Athabasca Basin projects whose economics depend on constructing standalone facilities. Survey results will guide an inaugural diamond drill programme tentatively scheduled to commence in early September 2026. For uranium investors watching the Athabasca Basin beyond the high-profile Paladin/Triple R and Denison/Phoenix corridors, the Aurora survey is the standard first step in the data-collection sequence that precedes maiden drill decisions — the period between airborne completion and drill permit application is historically the optimal capital allocation window for early-stage Basin explorers.

headline: GOLD X2 RAMPS TO 8 RIGS AND 160,000M AT 6.67MOZ MOSS GOLD, ONTARIO — LARGEST JUNIOR PROGRAM IN CANADA (TSXV:AUXX)
snippet: Gold X2 Mining Inc. (TSXV:AUXX / OTCQB:GSHRF) announced expansion of its fully funded 2026 programme at the Moss Gold Project in Northwest Ontario to 160,000 metres using eight drill rigs — one of the largest junior gold drilling campaigns currently active anywhere in Canada — with all eight rigs expected in simultaneous operation by the end of June 2026. The programme targets three concurrent workstreams: deposit de-risking through infill and geotechnical drilling, resource expansion at depth through step-out drilling, and 25,000 metres of brownfield exploration drilling on near-deposit targets with significant untested mineralisation potential. Moss Gold's current NI 43-101 Mineral Resource Estimate stands at 2.458 million ounces Indicated at 1.04 g/t Au and 4.209 million ounces Inferred at 0.97 g/t Au — a combined 6.67 million ounce resource base that is one of the largest among TSX Venture-listed juniors not yet at the Preliminary Economic Assessment stage. The project benefits from direct Trans-Canada Highway access and available hydroelectric power near site. Recent drilling has reinforced the case for the scale-up: Gold X2 intersected 86.0 metres grading 1.37 g/t gold from 314.0 metres at the QES target — finding gold where geological models predicted waste — a result that structurally justifies the 160,000-metre commitment and signals that the current resource outline materially undercalls the deposit's true size.

headline: ALAMOS GOLD BEST-EVER HOLE: 178 G/T AU OVER 3.5M AT CLINE-PICK — $43M DISTRICT BUDGET; MAGINO MILL FEED HUNT (TSX:AGI)
snippet: Alamos Gold Inc. (TSX/NYSE:AGI) released June 22, 2026 results from underground and surface drilling across the Island Gold District in northern Ontario, identifying multiple high-grade zones that represent potential additional higher-grade mill feed for the expanded Magino processing facility — recently upgraded to 15,000 tonnes per day capacity. The best result in company history came from the past-producing Cline-Pick mine, approximately seven kilometres from the Magino mill: 178 g/t gold over 3.5 metres. At Island West Extension, hole MX26-031 cut 5.2 metres grading 12.05 g/t gold from 968 metres depth, while MX26-035W returned 5.6 metres at 8.07 g/t from 928 metres. At the Edwards mine target, drilling intersected 13.60 metres at 5.06 g/t gold. Alamos has lifted its 2026 Island Gold District exploration budget to $43 million — up from $24 million in 2025 — targeting 50,000 metres of underground drilling to grow Mineral Reserves and Resources near existing workings. The strategic logic behind a major gold producer committing $43 million to district-scale exploration is directly instructive for junior investors: high-grade ounces found near existing infrastructure are worth materially more than equivalent ounces in greenfield projects, because the capital cost of extraction is orders of magnitude lower. A junior sitting within trucking distance of the Magino mill — or any comparable operating facility — warrants a proximity premium that most retail investors never explicitly price into their analysis.

headline: ASHLEY GOLD: 398 G/T AU GRAB IN NORTHERN TRENCH ZONE — HIGHEST IN COMPANY HISTORY, ABUTTING GOLIATH GOLD (CSE:ASHL)
snippet: Ashley Gold Corp. (CSE:ASHL) announced June 25, 2026 that first-pass prospecting in the Northern Trench Zone (NTZ) of its Tak property in Ontario's Dryden Area returned grab samples grading 398 g/t gold and 158 g/t gold — the highest assay values in the company's history — directly abutting Treasury Metals' Goliath Gold Complex, an advanced project with an established Mineral Resource of approximately 1.9 million ounces. The company also received its finalized induced polarization (IP) survey report, identifying high-chargeability anomalies coincident with the NTZ surface samples that provide drill targets for the next exploration phase. Phase 2 drilling at the Tak property is ongoing, with assay results pending. Important caveat: grab sample values reflect selective, high-grade hand specimens and cannot be extrapolated to define a resource — they indicate the presence of a mineralised system, not its size or continuity. What the NTZ results do establish is a structural question with clear binary value: whether the high-grade gold exposed in the Northern Trench Zone is part of the same mineralised system as the adjacent Goliath Gold Complex, or a distinct and previously unrecognised body. Drill results currently in the queue will answer that question. For speculative-capital investors in Ontario gold exploration, the proximity to a defined 1.9Moz resource with established infrastructure context is the frame that makes a 398 g/t grab sample worth tracking.

headline: PCE HIT 4.1% — WHY DID GOLD GO UP? GOLDSILVER UNPACKS THE COUNTER-INTUITIVE LOGIC OF IN-LINE INFLATION DATA (OPINION)
snippet: GoldSilver.com published an analysis explaining why gold rose on June 26-27 despite May's Personal Consumption Expenditures index printing at 4.1% — a number that, by conventional logic, confirms elevated inflation and should support further Federal Reserve rate hikes that are bearish for non-yielding gold. The answer lies in the qualifier 'in-line': markets had already priced in 4.1%+, so the number contained zero additional hawkish surprise. When data matches expectations exactly, the marginal impact on dollar and rate expectations is neutral; what moves markets is the gap between expectation and reality, not the absolute level. In this case, 4.1% in-line trimmed December rate-hike probability from 85% to 80% — a small but market-significant easing of the most extreme scenario, because a reading no worse than feared implies the Fed's current stance is doing enough work without requiring escalation. GoldSilver identifies three structural amplifiers that made gold particularly sensitive to this nuance: (1) positioning was historically extreme-short after four consecutive weekly declines, creating asymmetric snap-back potential on any bullish catalyst; (2) Asian physical buyers had been documented waiting for prices below $4,000, providing a demand floor that activated immediately when sentiment shifted; (3) month-end institutional rebalancing systematically adds gold exposure when the gold-to-equity ratio falls below historical norms — a condition reached this week. In-line data in the context of extreme shorts and month-end flows was sufficient to trigger a 3% intraday recovery: the kind of signal that matters more than the PCE headline itself.
